description: Independent demonstration QA/QC rules, not official SJRWMD acceptance standards.

rules.name: Missing station identifier
rules.interpretation: A station record lacks its identifier.

rules.name: Repeated station identifier
rules.interpretation: Multiple records share one station identifier. Investigate whether the service represents unique stations or multiple events.

rules.name: Missing or empty geometry
rules.interpretation: The feature cannot be located using its geometry.

rules.name: Invalid geometry
rules.interpretation: The geometry fails its structural validity test.

rules.name: Missing optional UTM attributes
rules.interpretation: One or both UTM attributes are absent. This does not establish an incorrect station location.

rules.name: Missing drilling depth
rules.interpretation: Drilling depth is unrecorded. Determine whether this field applies to the station.

rules.name: Missing completion date
rules.interpretation: Completion date is unrecorded. Review applicability and source-system history.

rules.name: Missing county
rules.interpretation: County is absent. Compare the station location with an authoritative county boundary.
